text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx on /v1/prompt-route (prompt_mux_new_endpoint canary) — 7.8% over 3m. Paging @oncall-amber and #incidents
oncall-amber: Acknowledged. Looking at canary dashboards. Noting rollout id rollout-20260317 to 25% ~18m ago.
sre-jamal: I see elevated grpc timeouts from endpoint-03 to model-server-03 in proxy logs. Collecting traces now.
eng-lead-ana: If this is causing customer errors, we should hit the kill-switch. Jamal — will FF -> 0 fully revert to stable router?
sre-jamal: Yes, it's a weighted feature flag. Setting it to 0 will route all traffic to prompt-router-stable. Command: ffctl set prompt_mux_new_endpoint 0 --force
deploy-bot: Executing: ffctl set prompt_mux_new_endpoint 0 --force
deploy-bot: Success: prompt_mux_new_endpoint is now 0. Rebalancing traffic away from canary.
incident-bot: Post-action: 5xx trend down to 1.2% over 1m. Continue to monitor for tail latency regressions.
prod-support: We already have three customer reports (AcmeCorp, BetaApps, GammaServices) reporting timeouts. CS looped in and sending 'we rolled back' note.
customer-success: On call with AcmeCorp; they saw ~6% failures, increased 95th latencies. They've asked for ETA on RCA and mitigation timeline.
eng-lead-ana: Thanks. Don't promise timeline; we'll investigate. Jamal, upload traces and any core dumps. Also add temp alert: auto-disable canary at sustained >2% 5xx for 2m.
sre-jamal: Uploaded logs bundle: https://s3.console.aws/incident-logs/1709998888/canary-logs.tar.gz . Initial findings: multiple connection reset_by_peer from model-server-03; also some OOM-kernel dmesg entries on that host.
eng-runtime: Assigned INC-2026-046 for full RCA. We'll freeze rollouts for this gate until resolved.
prod-support: Noted. CS will send status update to affected customers and track any escalations.
oncall-amber: Mitigation confirmed. Pager cleared for me. Action items: eng-runtime to investigate host OOMs, Jamal to submit PR for canary auto-kill and health-check tuning, CS to prepare customer communication, PM to review rollout schedule. Closing thread :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: prompt_mux_new_endpoint emergency disable applied. Follow-up ticket INC-2026-046 created.
